Platform: Linux administration, Git.
Services: REST API design, unit testing, CI pipelines.
Observability: Grafana, Prometheus.
Other: technical writing, mentoring, public speaking.
</document>

Assess the candidate against the posting below. Report the mandatory match

response.text:
# Mandatory Match: 70% (7 of 10)

**⚠️ Warning: This is below your 78% cutoff.**

| # | Mandatory Requirement | Match |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Python | ✅ |
| 2 | SQL | ✅ |
| 3 | Linux administration | ✅ |
| 4 | Git | ✅ |
| 5 | REST API design | ✅ |
| 6 | Unit testing | ✅ |
| 7 | CI pipelines | ✅ |
| 8 | Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Helm | ❌ None listed |
| 9 | Kafka | ❌ |
| 10 | GraphQL | ❌ |

**Gaps:** The résumé shows no container, orchestration, or infrastructure-as-code experience (item 8), no Kafka, and no GraphQL.

**Note on counting:** I treated item 8 as one requirement, as the posting numbers it. If you count its five tools separately, the match drops to 7 of 14 (50%). That is still below the cutoff.

As you instructed, I didn't evaluate the nice-to-have requirements.
